title: Build evidence-based customer personas
description: Group customers by observed needs, context and behaviour.
accomplishes: Group customers by observed needs, context and behaviour. Label evidence strength and unknowns. Produce a small set of useful personas and explain which decisions each supports. Avoid stereotypes, invented interviews and sensitive personal profiling.
prompt:
Act as a business strategy adviser.

Task: Build evidence-based customer personas.

Input context:
- OFFER: [OFFER]
- INTERVIEWS OR DATA: [INTERVIEWS OR DATA]
- SEGMENTS: [SEGMENTS]

Group customers by observed needs, context and behaviour. Label evidence strength and unknowns. Produce a small set of useful personas and explain which decisions each supports. Avoid stereotypes, invented interviews and sensitive personal profiling.

Distinguish verified facts, assumptions and scenarios. Example values are not verified market data.

Use English for explanations unless the task or user explicitly requires another language. Use clear sections and a format suited to the deliverable. If essential information is missing, ask a focused question before concluding. Label assumptions and unknowns. Do not invent facts, sources, results or completed checks. End with verification criteria and remaining limitations.
exampleResult:
## Provisional workshop persona
A time-constrained beginner wants a clear starting point and predictable equipment requirements. Evidence would need to come from supplied interviews or actual enquiry records. Age and income are not invented to make the persona look complete. Use the hypothesis to plan questions and messaging, then revise it when contradictory evidence appears.
